what: When the pointer enters a link, the letters change in sequence from the front within .15s to a new color (the original neon yellow) over .5s power2.out, and .3s before that ends they return in sequence from the first letter within .3s to their own color over 1.2s power1.out — even if the pointer leaves, the cycle runs to the end, and it is not retriggered while running. Menu and Footer links where a light sweeps once across the letters.

options.--fx-tint: Tint color (via style · css), default --kf-accent — the original is text on a blue background, so yellow (--kf-accent-text)
options.overlap: How much earlier the return starts than the tint end (sec), default .3

note: Not applied on finger screens (no hover) or reduced motion — the original also turns it off on phones and touch

from.where: shared.js [data-is-hover] (menu panel links · footer links — original main.js linkHoverAnimation: SplitText chars, color yellow-100 .5s power2.out stagger amount .15 → blue-100 1.2s power1.out amount .3 "-=0.3", isPlaying lock, off on sp·touch)
